verdict.rationale: GitLab offers a technology-partners integration directory listing many third-party apps: Slack, Notion, Make, Pulumi, Semgrep, and AI tools such as Cursor, Greptile, Kilo, and OpenCode that bring multi-model access. It also has an AI Catalog for discovering agents and flows built by GitLab and the community. However, the directory reads as a partner listing rather than a one-click install marketplace, and one community comment notes some third-party services don't integrate with GitLab. Missing for 10: a documented install-from-marketplace experience for apps, a marketplace of reusable CI/CD actions or components, first-party selection of AI models from a catalog, and independent hands-on corroboration.
